@zachleat @chriskirknielsen I don't know if you know that as well, but <input type="image"> was not just a submit button disguised as image. It would add x and y values to the form payload upon click. Those values indicated the coordinates as to where inside the image the user clicked so that the server could serve different content based on them. It was the server side version of image maps, predating the client side solution.
